Excellent
Jul 2026 • Family
We had an amazing dining experience at MARE. The food was delicious, the restaurant had a beautiful atmosphere, and everything was clean and well organized. The view was stunning, especially overlooking the fireworks, which made our evening even more memorable.

A special thank you to TIEN, who was incredibly kind, welcoming, and attentive throughout our visit. She made us feel comfortable from the moment we arrived and provided outstanding service with a genuine smile. She truly went above and beyond to make our experience special.

We also deeply appreciated how respectful the restaurant was of our culture and religion. As soon as we were seated, the staff thoughtfully removed the wine glasses from our table without us even having to ask. It was a small gesture that meant a lot to us.

We were also happy to find halal food options and suitable choices for Muslim guests. The team was open to listening to our suggestions and feedback, which made us feel valued as customers.

Highly recommended for anyone looking for excellent food, exceptional service, and a restaurant that truly respects its guests. We will definitely be back!

Could have been great but so frustrating
Mar 2026 • Family
After a long day at the water park, we decided to dine at Mare. The decor was lovely, and it was refreshingly cool inside. We ordered a margarita pizza and 4 cheese pizza, for me broccoli and opted for the pan-fried seabass,chosen from the picture but unfortunately, the seabass was forgotten, and no one came to the table to check if we were ok so I had to ask, We asked for sparkling water, but only still water was available.? 

The following night, my son was eager for another pizza since he loved it so much. This time, my husband tried the lasagna, which was nice. I just wanted a large glass of wine, but was informed that only normal glasses were available. So, I ordered two glasses and ended up combining them into one, as they took the empty glass away. Just seemed crazy…

To top off our meal, my son wanted dessert—a simple ice cream. However, the only options were tiramisu and affogato. When I asked for just ice cream, I was told it had to be served with coffee poured over it. This was quite frustrating, especially since I noticed at least 20 kids in the restaurant with no options for a straightforward dessert like ice cream. The trainee waiter was good, but it seems the staff and service could benefit from a bit more common sense when it comes to accommodating families.
